entry.title: [VahidOnline] Abbas Araghchi, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran, in…
entry.summary:
Machine-translated from the original Telegram post.

Source: @VahidOnline

Abbas Araghchi, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran, in an interview with the Iraqi television network "Al-Akhbariya," criticized the United States' conduct in diplomatic processes and stated that Tehran has entered into negotiations with the American side three times, but all three rounds of these talks ended in military confrontation and war. Emphasizing that these attacks occurred precisely in the middle of negotiations, Araghchi announced that it has been definitively proven to Tehran that no trust whatsoever can be placed in Washington at the negotiating table. He also said that although in the third round of talks they had reached a mutual understanding with Trump, the American president did not remain loyal to his pledge and his commitments lasted only two weeks, which has caused the Islamic Republic of Iran's trust in the American side to drop to zero.@VahidOOnLineMasoud Pezeshkian, in a meeting with Asim Munir, the Commander of the Pakistan Army, said: "All the problems in the region, from escalating tensions to disruption in the Strait of Hormuz, stem from America's warmongering nature. The Americans must answer why they essentially started a war and dragged themselves and the world into trouble and predicament."Pezeshkian added: "We know that war is neither in our interest, nor in the interest of the region and the world, nor even in America's interest. For any negotiations, they must first remove pressures, threats, and sanctions."He said: "Our nation today does not trust America and believes that if we negotiate, they will attack us again. They constantly propagandize in the media that they want to attack our country to frighten our people, while our nation has no fear of martyrdom."Pezeshkian, addressing the Commander of the Pakistan Army, added: "You, as our Muslim brothers, must make them understand that this is not how one treats Muslims. We do not want to impose our will on anyone, but we will not bow to force."@VahidOOnLine📡 @VahidOnline

Donald Trump, President of the United States, answered reporters' questions about war with Iran on Tuesday, 28 Mehr, on the sidelines of a meeting at the White House. Trump said: "I have to make the final decision about Iran — which way we want to win [the war]. Do we want to achieve victory the good way, or the bad way?" Trump, who had previously raised the possibility of using the "mother of all bombs," the largest non-nuclear bomb in the US arsenal, against nuclear facilities in Iran, did not explain what exactly he meant by the "good way" and the "bad way."@VahidOOnLine📡 @VahidOnline

entry.title: [VahidOnline] Asim Munir, the Chief of Army Staff of Pakistan, met with Masoud Pezeshkian,…
entry.summary:
Machine-translated from the original Telegram post.

Source: @VahidOnline

Asim Munir, the Chief of Army Staff of Pakistan, met with Masoud Pezeshkian, Mohammad-Baqer Qalibaf, and Mohsen Rezaei during his trip to Tehran. In his meeting with the Pakistani army chief, Rezaei emphasized that not even a single particle of Iran's enriched nuclear material will leave the country, and Qalibaf also said that America can only gain Tehran's trust by implementing the Islamic Republic's seven conditions.@VahidHeadlineAsim Munir, the Chief of Army Staff of Pakistan, met and held talks with President Masoud Pezeshkian, Mohammad-Baqer Qalibaf, the Speaker of the Islamic Consultative Assembly, and Mohsen Rezaei, the Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, on Tuesday, 28 Mehr, during his trip to Tehran.In these meetings, Mohammad-Baqer Qalibaf, referring to the Trump administration, accused it of violating the Islamabad memorandum and emphasized that America's record of negative actions has left Tehran at the peak of mistrust, and that military threats cannot influence Iran's strategic decisions. He added that Iran has no new position and that America cannot gain Iran's trust except by implementing the seven conditions, and it is Washington that must take the necessary steps to exit the quagmire of war with Iran.Meanwhile, Asim Munir announced regarding bilateral relations that the border issues between Iran and Pakistan were temporary and technical, and the borders of the two countries have been reopened as of today.@VahidOOnLine📡 @VahidOnline

Benjamin Netanyahu told Channel 14 Israel that the overthrow of the Islamic Republic is now on Mossad's and the Israeli military's agenda, and added that after delivering a "blow" to the Islamic Republic, he has issued the order to overthrow the Iranian regime. He also said that Israel may need to carry out an attack before the elections, and accused Iran and its proxy forces of trying to carry out attacks aimed at influencing the Israeli elections. Netanyahu added that Donald Trump also agrees with the overthrow of the Islamic Republic.@VahidOOnLineBenjamin Netanyahu, the Prime Minister of Israel, announced that the main goal of his government is the overthrow of the Islamic Republic, and according to him, with the fall of the Iranian regime, Lebanon's Hezbollah will also be eliminated. Netanyahu said on Tuesday, 28 Mehr, at the school year opening ceremony in the city of Kiryat Shmona, near the Lebanese border, that the Israeli military has made important progress in pushing back Hezbollah, but that he "is committed to finishing the job." He said: "Finishing the job means overthrowing the terrorist regime in Iran. This regime is a poisonous octopus; if we cut off its head, the other limbs will fall too."@VahidHeadlineNetanyahu said he has raised this issue more than once with Donald Trump, including two days ago. He added that as long as the Islamic Republic remains, it will strive to produce a nuclear bomb and rebuild its axis, and the only way to prevent that is to overthrow the regime.@VahidOOnLine📡 @VahidOnline
